senses.gloss: a failure that stops a machine, system, or process from working

translations.th_TH: การล้มเหลว

definition_translations.zh_TW: 使機器、系統或流程停止運作的故障
definition_translations.ja_JP: 機械、システム、過程の作動を止める故障

definition_translations.vi_VN: sự cố khiến máy móc, hệ thống hoặc quy trình ngừng hoạt động
definition_translations.th_TH: ความขัดข้องที่ทำให้เครื่องจักร ระบบ หรือกระบวนการหยุดทำงาน

senses.gloss: a detailed division or explanation of information into parts
senses.example: Please send a breakdown of the project costs by Friday.

senses.gloss: a serious loss of emotional control or mental health
senses.example: The employee took leave after a nervous breakdown.

example_translations.vi_VN: Nhân viên đó đã nghỉ phép sau một lần suy sụp tinh thần.

definition_translations.vi_VN: sự mất kiểm soát cảm xúc hoặc sức khỏe tinh thần nghiêm trọng
